answer.rationale: Do not broadly deploy promotional pricing: the recovered SMB discount result produced qualified-revenue lift but a -12% 30-day retention outcome and explicitly failed the sustainability criterion. Simplified onboarding has confirmed SMB-specific evidence of higher signup (+15%), activation (+9%), and qualified revenue (+4%), with a much smaller observed retention tradeoff (-1%). Run a standard SMB-focused implementation with retention and qualified-revenue guardrails; it is a more durable response than matching the competitor on price, while acknowledging it is not proven to directly neutralize price-driven churn.
